description: November 11 v6 hull and supplied hydrostatics loading; user-confirmed dimensions and 11-degree shaft angle. Equivalent-V estimates only.

length_m.meaning: 72 in external overall length from the v6 hydrostatics geometry.

beam_m.meaning: 16 in outer transom chine beam, including reverse-chine strips; not the 20.341 in overall width.

mass_kg.meaning: 153.595 lb from the same v6 hydrostatics CSV; blank masses excluded as authorized.

deadrise_deg.meaning: 15-degree main panel at transom, constant-V approximation; compare the 12.608842-degree outer-chine chord.

lcg_m.meaning: 27.30836079 in forward of transom, mass-weighted from v6 loading.

vcg_m.meaning: 5.54067365 in above aft keel, mass-weighted from v6 loading.

thrust_height_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, above keel; negative = below datum

thrust_x_m.meaning: Point on shaft line, forward of transom; negative = aft

thrust_angle_deg.meaning: Upward forward thrust angle relative to keel

roughness_m.meaning: Zero = smooth-hull assumption, disables roughness allowance

wetted_lengths_type.meaning: 2 = Savitsky 1964; this notebook supports only this geometry

flap_chord_m.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_span_ratio.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

flap_angle_deg.meaning: Zero; this notebook supports no flap

geometry_warning: v6 reverse chines and forward keel rocker; no uniform aft length assigned. Constant-V equivalent-hull estimate only.
assumptions: User-confirmed outer transom chine beam b=16 in and main V deadrise 15 deg.
Outer-chine chord 12.608842 deg is a comparison approximation; reverse-chine strips are not explicitly modeled.
Same v6 STEP source and component-masses.csv as hydrostatics, referenced directly with hashes; no duplicate geometry.
Raw STEP rim face is invalid, but reviewed exterior faces used for measurements are valid; see hydrostatics geometry report.
Forward keel rocker is present. No uniform aft length assigned; all solved points retain equivalent-hull geometry flags.
Partial loading: seven filled components only; thirteen missing weights excluded as authorized by the user.
Symmetric model ignores the small transverse CG offset; static trim/heel are not imposed as running trim.
User-confirmed thrust setup: 2 props, 11 deg shaft/thrust angle, reused v4 point 4.824 in aft and 1.292 in below aft keel.
Motor component CGs are not shaft thrust-line coordinates.
Freshwater at 20 C: density 998.2 kg/m3, viscosity 1.004e-6 m2/s; smooth hull and no flap.
Effective power is horizontal resistance times speed, not motor or battery power.
No displacement/transition resistance, appendages, air drag, waves, propeller interaction or dynamic-stability model.
Cv<1 is an evaluation cutoff, not planing onset.

review.notes: User confirmed measured dimensions and proposed reused two-prop thrust-line point, correcting shaft/thrust angle to 11 degrees.
